statement.zh: **事件**：《商用密码管理条例》修订（Revised Commercial Cryptography Regulation）。2023 年，《商用密码管理条例》完成修订并施行，进一步明确商用密码的检测认证、应用安全和监督管理。修订版与《密码法》衔接，把商用密码从产品管理扩展到关键信息基础设施和网络应用。
statement.en: **Event**: Revised Commercial Cryptography Regulation.It is registered under applied security engineering, dated 2023.

statement.zh: 《商用密码管理条例》修订的why见来源账本与正文其他节；该条目不以空段充数。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in applied security engineering, not because of its name.
